Proposed decision
Commission a site-specific grid connection and impact study before choosing a connection arrangement.
Rationale
The 25 MW course reference is a case assumption. It does not establish local grid capacity or effects on other customers.
Evidence
RTE's "Proposition Technique et Financière" (PTF) outlines the technical and financial aspects of connecting a new installation to the Public Electricity Transmission Grid, including network reinforcement requirements and cost allocation. ([services-rte.eu](https://www.services-rte.eu/en/learn-more-about-our-services/connect-an-installation-to-the-public-transmission-network.html?utm_source=openai)) 
Unknowns
Connection date, upgrades, queues, cost allocation and curtailment remain unconfirmed.
